[quoted text omitted]

The initial motivation was to remove all comments that start with `/*` from between a copyright banner and an include guard to simplify the linter code in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36805.

This PR provides the minimal diff to achieve that aim.

And these changes are real fixes for the Doxygen-generated docs rather than pure style changes.
